The above results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 were reviewed and recommended by the Audit Committee and subsequently approved by the Board of Directors in its Meeting held on October 26, 2026 and same were also subject to Limited Review by statutory auditors of the Company. The unaudited standalone financial results have been prepared in accordance with the recognition and measurement principles of Companies (Indian Accounting Standard) Rules, 2015 (Ind AS), as amended, prescribed under section 133 of the Companies Act 2013


The business activity of the Company falls within a single primary business segment viz " Textile Goods" and hence, there is no other reportable segment.

Net Sales/Income from operations includes export incentives.

A Debtors amounting to Rs. 1368.88 lacs is overdue for a period beyond 12 months. The Management is confident of its full recovery.

The figures for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 is the balancing figures between figures for the six months ended September 30, 2026 and the figures for the quarter ended June 30, 2026 which were subject to limited review by the Statutory Auditors.
The figures for the previous financial period/year figures have been re-classified/re-arranged/re-grouped wherever necessary to make them comparable.

The Deferred Tax Assest/Liablities will be determined and accounted at the end of the Financial Year.
